lines.text_source: "Well I'll be...![02]You all came here by[01]ship!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Que surpresa![02]Vocês vieram aqui de navio!?

lines.text_source: "Well I'll be...![02]You all came here by[01]ship!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Que surpresa![02]Vocês vieram aqui de navio!?

lines.text_source: "This here's Koshka.[02]We don't get that many[01]visitors, but when we do,[01]I let 'em stay at my place.[02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Meu nome eh Koshka.[02]Nao recebemos muitos visitantes, mas quando[01]recebemos, eu os deixo ficar na minha casa.[02][19]

lines.text_source: "Sorry. Didn't know[01]you didn't have[01]enough money."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Desculpa. Nao sabia que voces nao[01]tinham dinheiro suficiente.

lines.text_source: "Hey there, stranger.[01]Looking for something?[02]I got lots of stuff you[01]won't find anywhere else!"[12][84][0C][94]Buy[01]Sell[01]Trade[01]Never mind
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Oi, estranho.[01]Procurando algo?[02]Tenho um monte de coisas que voce[01]nao acha em lugar nenhum![12][84][0C][94]Comprar[01]Vender[01]Trocar[01]Nunca

lines.text_source: "While back, this merchant[01]came through here.[02]Said he was looking for...[01]What did he say? 'Rare and[01]unique goods,' he said.[02]Ever since then, all the[01]men here have got it in[02]their heads to sell things,[01]thinking they're[01]merchants themselves!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tempo atras, um mercador passou por aqui.[02]Disse que procurava... Como eh que ele disse? 'Mercadorias raras e unicas,' disse.[02]Desde entao, todos os homens daqui ficaram com vontade de vender coisas,[01]achando que sao mercadores!
lines.risk_notes: Comprimento em bytes; pt-BR mais longo. Simplificar sem perder tom casual.

lines.text_source: "Maybe I should try and[01]find something I can sell[01]myself...[02]I bet if I went to the En[01]Jhou ruins I could find[01]something..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Talvez eu devesse procurar algo para vender[01]eu mesmo...[02]Aposto que se eu fosse as ruinas de En[01]Jhou, eu acharia algo...

lines.text_source: "Where're the ruins, you[01]say?[02]If you mean the [05][02]En Jhou[06][01]ruins, they're to the east[01]of the Shan River."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: As ruinas, voce diz?[02]Se eh as [05][02]ruinas de En Jhou[06],[01]elas ficam a leste do Rio Shan.

lines.text_source: "You're going to go to the[01]ruins looking for lost[01]treasure?[02]You sound just like my[01]husband..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Voce vai nas ruinas procurando tesouro perdido?[02]Voce soa exatamente como meu[01]marido...

lines.text_source: "You're going to go to the[01]ruins looking for lost[01]treasure?[02]You sound just like my[01]husband..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Voce vai nas ruinas procurando tesouro perdido?[02]Voce soa exatamente como meu[01]marido...

lines.text_source: "Hey there, stranger. What?[01]Jars?[02]Yeah, I make jars. Why--you[01]want to buy one?"[12]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Oi, estranho. O que?[01]Jarras?[02]Sim, eu faço jarras. Por que -- voce quer comprar uma?[12]

lines.text_source: "Fine--suit yourself!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tudo bem -- como quiser!

lines.text_source: "All right then, I'll make[01]you one.[02]It'll take some time,[01]though--come back later."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tudo bem, eu faco uma para voce.[02]Vai levar tempo, mas--volta depois.

lines.text_source: "It's not ready yet. Come[01]back later."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Ainda nao esta pronta. Volta depois.

lines.text_source: "Well, it's finished.[02][19]
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Bem, esta pronta.[02][19]

lines.text_source: "Thanks!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Obrigado!

lines.text_source: "Why don't you come back[01]later with some money?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Por que nao volta depois com dinheiro?

lines.text_source: "I remember when I was a[01]kid, they'd make those jars[01]and give them to people.[02]But now we get people[01]coming from all over to[01]buy them..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Lembro quando eu era criança, eles faziam aquelas jarras[01]e davam para as pessoas.[02]Mas agora a gente recebe gente de todo lugar[01]comprando...

lines.text_source: "I never would've guessed[01]there was something like[01]that still in the ruins...[02]I should've looked[01]harder!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Nunca imaginei que havia algo assim[01]ainda nas ruinas...[02]Deveria ter procurado[01]melhor!

lines.text_source: "Bet you didn't find[01]anything of value in those[01]ruins, did you?[02]That's because everyone[01]here's already taken[02]everything that's worth[01]anything and sold it[01]off!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Aposto que voce nao achou nada valioso nas ruinas, achou?[02]Eh porque todo mundo aqui ja[02]pegou tudo que valia a pena e[01]vendeu!
lines.risk_notes: Comprimento; tom cynical deve se manter conciso.

lines.text_source: "Huh? Which way's the[01]capital, you say?[02]Hmmm...I forget...We don't[01]get out that way much, you[01]know..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Huh? Qual eh o caminho para a capital, voce diz?[02]Hmm... Nao lembro...[01]A gente nao sai por la muito, sabe...
